integrity: The sign and sharp coefficient are supported by an analytic proof; numerical checks are supplemental and do not replace all-parameter reasoning. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Each positive squared radius is fixed before varying the anisotropy parameter locally. No finite-interval monotonicity, all-parameter uniqueness, or independent priority certification is claimed. Relevant full literature is partly inaccessible.
title: Strictly positive period response to cubic-velocity anisotropy in a hybrid oscillator
